title: Sweet but healthy? Evaluating Honey vs. Sugar in Recipes
summary: Does honey's healthy reputation hold up? Comparing honey and sugar desserts using recipe data and permutation tests.
description: Utilized real world recipe data (from Food.com) to compare nutritional values in Honey and Sugar desserts. Recipes were cleaned, accounting for missingness and filtered by ingredients to contain Sugar and Honey only desserts. Hypothesis tests, such as a permutation test, were used to assess whether this “halo effect” on honey was supported by measurable differences.

title: League of Legends Analysis: Wards vs. Dragons
summary: Exploring how vision control relates to dragon objectives in League of Legends Worlds games, with a predictive random forest model.
description: Analyzed data from League of Legends World Championship (Worlds) games to analyze the relationship between the wards placed in a game, and the number of dragons that team secured. Cleaned data, assessing for missingness, and outliers; depicted visualizations on the initial data, demonstrating relationships between the two groups. Implemented a predictive algorithm, utilizing sklearn's Random Forests to estimate the number of dragons based on ward related data.

title: The World Is Getting Greener — But Momentum Is Uneven.
summary: An interactive look at changing vegetation across the Americas, using NASA satellite data to tell a story about the Amazon.
description: Ultized NASA MODIS data to create an interactive visualization, allowing for comparison of vegetation across different regions and time periods within the Americas. Implemented scrollytelling to give statistics regarding the Amazon region.
